sections.heading: What an online tutor in Mumbai will never do with your child's essay
paragraphs: Saying this twice on one page is deliberate, because remote work makes the wrong version easy and invisible. A tutor may teach research and writing skills, question a draft the student has written, and mark that draft against the published criteria. A tutor may never write, redraft, research for, or produce any part of an Extended Essay. The student submits it as her own work and signs a declaration that it is. Any use of AI tools is declared by her under her school's own rules, and no tutor decides that for her. IB Gram will not accept work framed as producing or fixing a submission.

Progress on this mode of working looks specific. At four weeks there is a document with a comment history in it, a dated search log, a reference list built while reading rather than afterwards, and a question that has narrowed. She can also tell you what her last two comments said and what she did about them. If the document has no comment threads at four weeks, the work is not happening, whatever the session attendance says.

At one term the reading is largely done, there is a section-by-section outline mapping evidence to argument, and at least one full section has been through two rounds of comments. Across a full exam cycle the essay is finished early enough to be defended in conversation with her supervisor, and the habit transfers: students who learn to answer a comment instead of deleting the paragraph stop losing Internal Assessment marks for unsupported claims. The grade depends on her work, her school and the examiner, and we do not guarantee grades.

The limits are worth naming. An online tutor cannot make a student open a document. He cannot see whether the reading in the log actually happened. He cannot attend a supervised reflection session, and he should not want to. And if what a family wants is for someone else to produce the essay, no version of our service supplies it, remote or in person. We would rather lose the enquiry in October than have a candidate investigated in May.

sections.heading: Booking an online or home tutor in Mumbai for the Extended Essay
paragraphs: To start, send four things: the essay subject, whether your child is in DP1 or DP2, the weekly windows that are genuinely free, and the research question as it is currently written even if it is three words long. If the supervisor has left a written comment, forward that too. Parents who search for IB tutors near me Mumbai often assume an online match needs less information than a local one, when it needs the same information and one extra item, which is the shape of the week.

Session one lasts about ninety minutes and runs on your child's screen. She opens her document, her search history and whatever notes exist. The tutor asks her to state the question aloud and then to show him how she found her last source. By the end there is a one-page plan in her document: what to read, what to search, what goes in the log, and the draft and marking days for the term. You receive the plan and the rhythm by email so you can see what was agreed without sitting in the session.

If you want to compare, ask for two profiles. Three questions separate a research tutor from a subject teacher on this assessment: how do you narrow a question, how do you comment on a paragraph that is not working, and what will you refuse to do. Ask the third one first. An IB private tutor Mumbai parents hire for Extended Essay work should answer it in a sentence, without hedging, and should volunteer the comment-access setting before you ask.

What we will not accept is a booking that is really a request for text. If you write to us in the last fortnight before submission asking for someone to tidy up or complete an essay, we will tell you what is legitimately available in that window, which is advice she applies herself and an honest look at what can still be cut and fixed. That answer disappoints some families. It is the only answer that leaves the diploma intact.

faqs.question: Does online tutoring really work for the Extended Essay?
faqs.answer: Better than for most subjects, because the work is reading, thinking and writing rather than anything that needs a shared physical space. The essay already lives in a document, so comments, marking and search coaching all transfer to a screen without loss. What does not transfer is physical accountability: a student who only works when someone is in the room will not be rescued by a video call. Online suits a student who will write between sessions and needs sharper feedback on what she wrote. It does not suit a student who has stopped working altogether.

faqs.question: Who types in the shared document during an online session?
faqs.answer: Only your child, and we set the permissions so that it cannot be otherwise. The tutor is given comment access rather than edit access, suggestion mode is not used, and no tracked change is ever proposed. Every edit in the revision history appears in her name because she made it. If a paragraph is beyond repair, the comment says which criterion it fails and why, and she writes the replacement. You can verify all of this yourself in two minutes by opening the document's version history, and we encourage you to do exactly that in week two.

faqs.question: A tutor offered to clean up my son's draft and send it back before submission. Can you do a last-minute polish?
faqs.answer: No, and the offer you were made is one to be wary of. We will not write, rewrite, complete, research or polish an Extended Essay at any stage, and we do not take bookings described that way. In the last fortnight what we will do is teach him to check his own referencing against his school's required format, read each section against the relevant criterion so he can cut what is not serving it, and plan the hours he has left. He types every change. If the request is for finished text produced by someone else, we are the wrong service.

faqs.question: Can a tutor still travel to our home in Malad West if online sessions are not working?
faqs.answer: Yes, and we would switch rather than persist. If the online rhythm has not held by week four, a home tutor in Malad West or along the Link Road towards Kandivali is usually matchable for a weekly slot, and many families keep the online specialist for marking while a local tutor handles the in-person hour. Be realistic about the slot: a tutor coming north along the Western Express Highway at 6pm will not arrive at the same time each week, so an 8pm start or a weekend morning holds far better across a full term.

faqs.question: Our building has patchy Wi-Fi in the evening. Does that break online sessions?
faqs.answer: Not usually, because this work needs a document and a voice rather than high-quality video. Turn the tutor's video off and keep the screen share, which costs a fraction of the bandwidth, and agree a fallback in advance: a phone call on the same document, or a shift to the next evening. Several of our Thane and Vashi families run sessions on a mobile hotspot for this reason. Agree the fallback in session one, because the week it is needed is the week nobody wants to be deciding.

faqs.question: What does the tutor actually do between sessions?
faqs.answer: He reads whatever your child submitted and returns it annotated, usually within a day or two. That means comments attached to specific sentences, each tagged with the criterion it concerns, plus a short written summary naming the two things to fix and the one thing to keep. He does not rewrite anything. The purpose is to move reading and marking out of the live hour so that the live hour is spent on argument and scope, which is the part a student cannot do alone. The marking schedule is fixed at the start of the term.

faqs.question: Can an online Extended Essay tutor be matched from outside Mumbai?
faqs.answer: Yes, and for niche subjects that is often the point. If the essay is in Philosophy, Film, Music, Global Politics or a less commonly taught language, the pool of genuine specialists inside the city is small, and an online match widens it to wherever the right person is. We tell you where the tutor is based and what time zone he works in before you book, and we will not schedule a session at an hour that only suits him. For widely taught subjects we usually have local options and will offer both.

faqs.question: What do IB tuition fees in Mumbai depend on for online Extended Essay work?
faqs.answer: Subject scarcity first, then the tutor's research credential, then session length and how much written marking is included. Online removes travel from the equation, which is one of the larger variables in an in-person rate, but a specialist in a thinly staffed subject still commands more than a generalist. The between-session marking is a real cost in a tutor's week, so a package with weekly annotated drafts prices differently from one with sessions only. We quote per match rather than publishing a figure, and we tell you what the marking commitment covers.

faqs.question: Does the online tutor speak to our school's Extended Essay supervisor?
faqs.answer: No. The supervisor is appointed by the school, holds the supervised reflection sessions and signs the official record, and a tutor neither replaces that relationship nor contacts the school. The tutor's job is to make sure your child walks into each reflection session able to describe her own progress honestly. If the supervisor has written something, forward it and the tutor will work with it. Every message that goes back to the school comes from your child or from you, never from us.

faqs.question: There has been no progress after a month of online sessions. What now?
faqs.answer: Open the document before you draw a conclusion, then tell us that week. If there are comment threads, a dated search log and a narrower question, the work is happening and the expectation of visible prose is simply early. If the document is unchanged since week one, the online mode is not holding attention and the answer is usually structural: a shorter weekly check-in, a fixed draft day, or a move to home tuition. We would rather rematch in week five than hear about it at the end of the term.

faqs.question: How do we replace an online tutor who is not working out?
faqs.answer: Message us with what specifically did not work and we send fresh profiles. On online Extended Essay matches the two usual causes are comment style and cadence: a tutor whose comments tell rather than ask leaves the student with nothing to do, and a tutor who marks slowly breaks the rhythm the whole design depends on. Both are fixable by rematching rather than by negotiating. The new tutor gets comment access to the same document and can see the previous threads, so nothing restarts from zero, and nothing about the change goes to the school.

faqs.question: Can my son use AI to summarise papers if the work is all online?
faqs.answer: Only if his school's published rules allow it, and whatever he uses he declares himself. Schools differ and the rules are being revised, so the authority is your DP coordinator's current guidance rather than a tutor's view. A tutor will teach him the difference between a tool that helps him locate or organise material and a tool that produces text or analysis he then submits, because the second one puts his diploma at risk. Anything a model wrote is not his work, and the declaration he signs says the essay is.

sections.heading: How IB Gram handles a private Extended Essay enquiry in Mumbai
paragraphs: Our first question on an Extended Essay enquiry is not which subject. It is what has already gone wrong. Private one-to-one help on this assessment is a precise instrument and the three problems it fixes are different from each other, so a tutor matched without knowing which one you have will spend a month finding out. A student who cannot begin needs a planning session and a schedule. A student with a question that is too broad needs an hour of hard interrogation. A student who has drifted for a term needs triage and a frank conversation with you in the room. Most of these arrangements run as weekly home tuition, so naming the problem also decides what the first home session is for.

So the sequence is this. 1. You describe the problem in your own words, including what the supervisor has said and what has not happened since. 2. We tell you honestly whether a private tutor is the right answer, which sometimes it is not. 3. We shortlist on subject match and on the specific problem, then send profiles with each tutor's research background and his available slots. 4. You speak to two of them and ask both what they will refuse to do. 5. The first session produces a written plan with dates, and the student owns every task in it.

Step two genuinely results in us saying no. If a DP1 student has a workable question, a responsive supervisor and a habit of meeting school deadlines, a private tutor adds very little and we will say so rather than bill you for reassurance. If a DP2 student is six weeks from submission with no reading done, no tutor can legitimately fix that and we will say that too. Hiring in the middle of the project, for a stated problem, is where the money does something.

The boundary is set before any booking. A tutor may teach skills, question a draft the student has written, and mark it against the published criteria so she knows where it stands. A tutor may never write, redraft, research for, or produce any part of an Extended Essay. The student signs it as her own work, any AI use is declared by her under her school's rules, and the supervisor appointed by her school is not replaced or contacted by anyone we match.

sections.heading: The Diploma Programme core, and why DP2 is where this breaks
paragraphs: The Extended Essay (EE) is one of the core requirements of the International Baccalaureate (IB) Diploma Programme (DP), sitting with Theory of Knowledge (TOK) and the creativity, activity, service strand. It is independent research in a subject the student chooses, supervised inside the school by a teacher the school appoints, written across DP1 and submitted in DP2. The supervisor holds the scheduled reflection sessions and the Reflections on Planning and Progress Form. A private tutor sits outside that structure entirely and does not communicate with the school.

Dates, the word limit and the format of the reflections belong to the current subject guide and your DP coordinator. Guides are revised on the IB's own cycle, so any tutor quoting those details from memory is guessing and any page quoting them to you may be a year out. Ask the coordinator for the version that applies to your child's session. Everything in a private tutoring plan should be pinned to those dates, which is one of the few concrete things a first session can deliver in an hour.

The structural problem with DP2 is that the Extended Essay has no weekly lesson protecting it. Subject classes continue, Internal Assessments arrive with teacher-set deadlines, mock examinations are timetabled, and the essay is the only major piece of work with no fixed slot in the week. Given a choice between an Internal Assessment due Friday and an essay due in four months, every rational student picks Friday. That is not laziness. It is the timetable working as designed, against the essay.

A private tutor's real function in DP2 is to be the fixed slot. An Extended Essay (EE) IB Diploma Programme (DP), Years 1-2 tutor Mumbai parents hire in the middle of the project is buying a recurring commitment in a week that otherwise contains none, plus someone who can tell the student which of her four deadlines actually matters this fortnight. Triage is a larger part of the value than teaching, and nobody advertises it.

School-appointed supervisor is never replaced or contacted by a tutor

sections.heading: Is a private tutor worth it for your child's Extended Essay subject?
paragraphs: It depends almost entirely on whether the subject makes the essay harder to research than to write. In History, Global Politics and Economics the difficulty is evidence: a student can write fluently and still have nothing solid underneath, and a subject specialist who presses on sources earns his hour. In the sciences the difficulty is feasibility: an experimental question needs equipment, repeatability and a site, and a tutor who has run research can tell in twenty minutes whether a design will produce usable data. In Literature and Language the difficulty is argument, and the useful help is someone who refuses to accept a claim about a text without a line reference.

Where a private tutor adds least is a subject the school teaches intensively and supervises closely, with a student who is already meeting internal deadlines. Paying for a tutor there buys duplication. Where he adds most is a subject with few local specialists, because a general IB tutor asking general questions about a Philosophy or Film essay will keep the student busy without moving the argument. An Extended Essay (EE) tutor in Mumbai who has not done research in the relevant field is a tutor who will nod at the wrong things.

The published criteria reward focus and method, subject knowledge, critical thinking, presentation and the student's own reflection. A subject specialist is worth the money mostly on the middle three, because those are where a non-specialist cannot tell strong work from confident work. Presentation and reflection are teachable by anyone competent, and some of it the student can fix from her school's own guidance without paying anybody.

A useful test before you hire: ask the tutor what he would want to see in the first fifteen minutes, and listen for whether he asks about evidence or about the writing. On this assessment the answer should be evidence. Then ask what he does if the student's question turns out to be unanswerable. The right answer involves the student taking a revised question to her supervisor, not the tutor supplying a new one.

sections.heading: Private and home tuition across Mumbai, zone by zone
paragraphs: An IB DP extended essay private tutor in Mumbai is matched by zone because a one-to-one slot that depends on an unreliable commute stops being one-to-one by November. In South Mumbai we match within the island across Cuffe Parade, Churchgate, Grant Road, Mumbai Central, Tardeo, Haji Ali, Babulnath and Worli. The island is where in-person specialists are densest and where families most often want a tutor in the room, and Metro Line 3 has made the Cuffe Parade to Bandra Kurla Complex run far more predictable than the Peddar Road signals ever were.

In the Western Suburbs we cover Bandra, Khar, Santacruz West, Juhu, Andheri West, Goregaon East, Kandivali and Borivali, with the Sea Link and the Western Express Highway shaping who can hold which slot. A tutor living in Khar can serve Santacruz West and Bandra on a weekday evening and cannot serve Borivali, whatever the map says. The Central Suburbs run along the Central Line from Kurla through Ghatkopar and Kanjurmarg, with Powai and Chandivali reached off the JVLR and Metro Line 1 connecting Ghatkopar to Andheri; Powai families get the widest in-person choice in the zone because tutors come to it from three directions.

The Eastern Suburbs cover Chembur, Wadala, Govandi, Vikhroli, Bhandup and Mulund, where the Eastern Express Highway, the Eastern Freeway and the Monorail to Wadala decide the schedule, and the SCLR brings Santacruz tutors across for a weekend slot. Navi Mumbai is matched node to node across Vashi, Nerul, Belapur, Kharghar and Panvel along Palm Beach Road and the Sion-Panvel Highway, with the Atal Setu and the Trans-Harbour Line useful for a weekend session and not for a Tuesday. Thane runs from the station through Majiwada and Hiranandani Estate out along Pokhran Road and Ghodbunder Road to Kasarvadavali, and the Thane-Borivali tunnel corridor will change that calculation when it opens.

The zone also changes the honest advice about mode. A family in Worli or Powai can expect a specialist at the table weekly. A family in Panvel or Kasarvadavali asking for a weekly in-person specialist in a niche subject is usually choosing between a nearby generalist and a distant specialist, and on this assessment the specialist matters more. So IB home tuition in Mumbai is the default on the island and in the central corridor, and a hybrid is the realistic answer at the edges.

sections.heading: When does the essay collide with IAs and mocks in Mumbai?
paragraphs: The collision is predictable and it is why most private Extended Essay enquiries arrive when they do. Mumbai IB schools set internal essay milestones inside the IB's outer deadline, and the first full draft is usually wanted around the DP1 to DP2 transition. That is the same stretch in which Internal Assessment drafts fall in two or three subjects and the TOK essay is live. Later in DP2 come mock examinations and, for most families here, university applications. Ask your DP coordinator for the published dates and lay them on one page; the clashes become obvious immediately.

The shape of the squeeze differs by school rather than by zone. A student at Dhirubhai Ambani International School or the American School of Bombay in Bandra Kurla Complex may face an earlier internal draft deadline than a student at NES International School in Mulund West or Thakur International School in Kandivali East, and a student at B.D. Somani International School in Cuffe Parade, Cathedral and John Connon School in Fort or Bombay International School in Babulnath will be working to that school's own reflection schedule. Naming a school is local context and nothing more. IB Gram is an independent platform, not affiliated with any school named here, and not affiliated with the International Baccalaureate organisation.

What a private tutor does in that squeeze is unfashionable and valuable: he decides what gets dropped. In a fortnight containing an Internal Assessment draft, a TOK outline and an essay section, something will be late, and a student choosing at random will usually protect the thing due soonest rather than the thing that takes longest to recover. A tutor who knows the calendar can tell her to write four hundred words of the essay's methodology this week and let the TOK outline be rough, because one of those is recoverable in an evening and the other is not.

Two periods are worth marking now. The monsoon weeks from June to September cancel in-person sessions, and a project with no makeup rule written into the schedule simply pauses for a month. The Diwali to December window in DP2 is when the essay, mocks and applications arrive together, and anything not finished by then will be finished badly. A tutor hired in April is managing a calendar. A tutor hired in December is managing a loss. If you are booking home classes for the monsoon term, write the makeup rule into the schedule in the first week.

sections.heading: One-to-one at home, online, or a mix for private EE support?
paragraphs: Home is the mode most families want and the one we lead with, and an IB DP extended essay private tutor in Mumbai usually works as a home tutor for an hour a week at the table rather than as a remote consultant. An IB home tutor in Mumbai sitting at the dining table can see the printouts, the log and the open tabs, and can interrupt a bad habit while it is happening. For the student who has drifted, a person arriving at a fixed hour is the mechanism, not the teaching: the week has a deadline in it again. Extended Essay (EE) home classes Mumbai tutors travel to work best at the two heavy points in the project, which are the planning session and the first full drafting review.

Online is the better answer when the subject is scarce or the commute is long. An IB online tutor in Mumbai can be matched on research background rather than on postcode, short check-ins become viable because nobody is spending an hour in traffic for twenty-five minutes of work, and written marking between sessions costs no travel at all. The trade-off is attention and honesty: a student can conceal the state of her reading on a screen more easily than across a table, and on this assessment concealment is the failure that matters.

Most private Extended Essay arrangements we set up end as a hybrid split by task. The planning session and the drafting review happen at home. The weekly fifteen to twenty-five minute check-in and the marking happen online. That split keeps the expensive travel for the sessions that need a table and keeps the cadence that keeps a long project alive. Nothing about the mode changes the boundary: in both, the student holds the keyboard and the tutor holds a question.

One mode warning specific to private hiring. A tutor engaged privately, with no platform and no record, in an online-only arrangement, is the configuration in which the line gets crossed quietly. There is no comment history, no revision trail, and nobody but the tutor knows what he typed. If you hire outside a platform, insist on comment access only, keep the document in your child's account, and read the version history yourself. That is five minutes a fortnight and it is the only check that cannot be talked around.

Online for scarce subjects, short check-ins and written marking

sections.heading: What to check before you hire a private EE tutor in Mumbai
paragraphs: We check identity, the subject credential at the level the essay needs, and whether the tutor has actually supervised or assessed research rather than only taught a syllabus. Then we ask him to state the boundary in his own words. An IB DP extended essay private tutor in Mumbai who answers that question with a clear rule gets listed. One who starts distinguishing between heavy editing and light editing does not, because on an assessment the student has to sign, that distinction is the entire risk and a tutor who finds it interesting is a liability.

Your own checks are short. Ask what he studied and at what level. Ask for one example of a question he made a student narrow, and listen for whether the student did the narrowing. Ask how he records what happened between sessions. Ask what he will refuse to do. Then look at the document yourself and confirm every change is in your child's name. Be wary of a tutor who promises a specific grade, and be wary of one who offers to send back an improved version of the draft. IB Gram does not guarantee grades, and a tutor who implies otherwise is telling you something useful about himself.

There are warning signs on the hiring side too, which nobody mentions because they are about the parent. If the enquiry you are about to send contains the words finish, polish, fix, clean up, or make sure it is ready, pause on it. Those words describe work on the text rather than work on the student, and a tutor who accepts an enquiry phrased that way has already agreed to something he should not. We answer those enquiries by rewriting the request out loud before quoting on it, whether the booking is for home tuition or for online sessions.

Keep a light record at home: which day the tutor came, what the student was asked to do before the next session, and whether she did it. At four weeks answer one question honestly. Is she doing more of this herself than she was in week one, or less? On private one-to-one work, less is the signal to stop, because the only direction that can go is somewhere you do not want to be.
bullets: Credential, research experience, and the boundary stated in his own words
Ask for an example where the student did the narrowing
Check every change in the document is in your child's name

sections.heading: The three students a private Extended Essay tutor genuinely helps
paragraphs: The first is the student who has a supervisor, has a subject, and still cannot start. Nothing is wrong with her ability. She has a blank document, a vague topic, no sense of what a finished essay looks like, and a deadline far enough away that starting badly feels worse than not starting. One session fixes a surprising amount of this: she states the topic aloud, a tutor asks her to name three things somebody could disagree about within it, she picks one, and she leaves with four hours of defined reading and a date. A private tutor is worth paying for here because the blockage is a first move, and a first move is cheap to supply without touching her work.

The second is the student whose question is too broad and who has nobody pressing on it. Supervisors in Mumbai schools carry several essays alongside a full teaching load, and a question that is merely acceptable will often pass unchallenged. Acceptable questions produce thin essays. The useful hour here is adversarial: what would count as evidence for this, where would it be, how many cases does your argument need, what happens to your answer if the third case contradicts you. The student leaves with a narrower question she wrote herself and takes to her supervisor. That hour is the highest-value hour on this page.

The third is the student who has drifted for a term. This one needs triage and it needs you present for the first twenty minutes. What exists, what is real, what is salvageable, what date is genuinely unmovable. The honest output is sometimes a smaller essay than she imagined: a narrower question that her existing reading can actually answer, written in the time that remains. That is a legitimate recovery. Starting a fresh ambitious project in DP2 is not, and a tutor who agrees to one is being polite rather than useful.

Then the realistic help budget, since nobody states it. Across the whole project the legitimately useful contact time is modest: a planning session, a question-interrogation session, a weekly short check-in through the reading months, a review after the first full draft, and a conversation before the final reflection. That is a weekly hour at most, concentrated at four or five points, and a tutor proposing far more than that on an independent research essay is either padding or planning to do work that is not his to do. A home tutor for Extended Essay (EE) Mumbai families engage for that shape of support is buying structure, and an IB DP extended essay private tutor in Mumbai who proposes that shape is telling you he understands the assessment. A tutor booked for three sessions a week in DP2 is being set up to produce text, whatever anybody intends.

Question too broad: an adversarial hour on evidence and scope

sections.heading: The requests we turn down, and why asking puts a candidate at risk
paragraphs: We will not write an Extended Essay or any part of one. We will not research one, which includes supplying a reading list, finding the sources or producing a reference list. We will not fix one in the week before submission, and we will not take a brief to make sure it is ready. A tutor may teach skills, question a draft the student has written and mark it against the published criteria, and that is the whole of what is on offer. The student submits the essay as her own work and signs a declaration saying so, and any AI use is declared by her under her school's own rules.

The reason we are blunt about this is that the risk sits entirely on the candidate and not on the tutor. A school that forms a view about the authorship of an essay acts against the student, and the consequences run to the diploma itself rather than to a mark on one component. A parent paying for text believes they are buying insurance. They are buying the one risk that cannot be insured against, and they are buying it for someone who did not choose it. The tutor who took the money is unaffected either way, which tells you how to read anyone who offers.

What a family actually gets for legitimate help is still substantial. At four weeks there is a narrower question, a dated research log, a reference list built while reading, and a student who can explain her argument to you without notes. At one term the reading is done and the outline maps evidence to sections. Across an exam cycle the essay is finished with time to defend it in conversation with her supervisor, and the research habits show up in her Internal Assessments. The grade depends on her work, her school's teaching and the examiner, and we do not guarantee grades.

If a tutor is not working out, tell us and we rematch, with no explanation required beyond what specifically went wrong. On private Extended Essay matches the usual causes are subject distance and pace, and both are fixed by changing the tutor rather than by negotiating with him. Nothing about a rematch goes to your school. And if our answer to your enquiry is that no private tutor can honestly do what you are asking, that answer is free and it arrives before you have spent anything.

sections.heading: Hiring an IB home tutor in Mumbai for Extended Essay support
paragraphs: Start by describing the problem rather than the subject. Tell us whether your child cannot start, has a question nobody has pressed on, or has lost a term, and send the question as currently written, the supervisor's last comment, and the date of the next internal milestone. Parents who search for IB tutors near me Mumbai usually open with the subject and the pin code, and both matter less than the sentence describing what has not happened for the last six weeks.

You will get a straight answer about whether to hire at all. If a private tutor is the right call, two or three profiles follow within a working day, each showing the tutor's research background, his honest travel radius and the slots he can hold through a full term rather than through September. Speak to two. The first question to ask is what he will refuse to do, and the second is what he would want to see in the first fifteen minutes.

The first session is ninety minutes and ends in writing. For a student who cannot start, that means a defined reading list she assembled with guidance on where to look, and a date. For a broad question, a narrower question in her own words to take to her supervisor. For a drifted term, a triage sheet listing what exists, what is salvageable and what is being abandoned. You get the plan by email. Whether the arrangement runs as IB home tuition in Mumbai, online sessions, or the usual hybrid, that plan is the deliverable.

If what you want is an essay produced or repaired, we are the wrong platform and we will tell you so in the first reply rather than after a deposit. An IB private tutor Mumbai parents hire in the final fortnight cannot legitimately supply a finished essay, and the person who carries the consequence of pretending otherwise is the candidate. Hire in DP1 or early DP2, hire for a stated problem, and keep the keyboard with your child.

faqs.question: When is a private Extended Essay tutor actually worth the money?
faqs.answer: In three situations: your child cannot start, her question is too broad and nobody is pressing on it, or she has drifted for a term and needs triage. Outside those, a private tutor usually duplicates what a responsive supervisor is already doing and we will tell you so. The value is concentrated rather than continuous, which is why we match for a stated problem rather than selling a term of general essay support. Families who book an IB DP extended essay private tutor in Mumbai for one of those three problems get far more from a term of home tuition than families who book because everybody else has. If you cannot name the problem in a sentence, the first conversation should be with the supervisor, not with us.

faqs.question: My son's essay is due in nine days and is half written. Can someone help finish or polish it?
faqs.answer: No. We will not finish, rewrite, research or polish an Extended Essay, and we do not accept bookings framed that way at any point in the project. In nine days what we will legitimately do is read nothing on his behalf, have him talk us through each section, show him how to check his referencing and formatting against his school's requirements, help him read each section against the relevant criterion so he can cut and repair it himself, and plan the hours he has left. He types every change. If what is wanted is text written by somebody else, we are the wrong service and we say so immediately.

faqs.question: Can a private tutor travel to our home in Chembur for an evening slot?
faqs.answer: Yes, Chembur is one of the easier matches in the Eastern Suburbs. Tutors reach it from Wadala and Govandi on the Harbour Line, from Ghatkopar and Vikhroli along the Eastern Express Highway, and from Santacruz across the SCLR, so a weekday evening slot holds through a full term. The one thing to fix in advance is the start time: a tutor crossing the SCLR at 6pm will be inconsistent, while a 7.30pm or weekend-morning start is reliable. Lock the slot in writing in week one and keep it, because consistency matters more on this project than on any other.

faqs.question: What does our society or building need to arrange for a weekly tutor visit?
faqs.answer: A standing visitor authorisation rather than a fresh negotiation every week. Most Mumbai societies will add a recurring visitor to the register on a written request from a resident, and many now approve entry through an app, which means somebody at home has to tap approve at seven on a Thursday. Give us the tutor's name exactly as it appears on his identity document so the gate record matches, and tell us if the building requires a photo entry. Ten minutes of paperwork now prevents the twenty-minute delay that eats a quarter of a session later, and a home tutor who is cleared once rarely loses time at the gate again.

faqs.question: What do IB tuition fees in Mumbai depend on for private Extended Essay work?
faqs.answer: Subject scarcity, the tutor's research credential, travel distance, session length and how much written marking is included. An essay in a thinly staffed subject costs more than one in a widely taught subject because the pool is small. Travel matters because a tutor crossing a zone is spending an evening he cannot bill elsewhere. Written marking between sessions is real work in his week and is priced as such. We quote per match instead of publishing a list, and we would rather tell you that the concentrated shape of help costs less overall than a weekly session for a year.

faqs.question: Why is it risky for a family to ask a tutor to write part of the essay?
faqs.answer: Because the consequence falls on your child and not on the tutor. The student signs a declaration that the essay is her own work, and a school that forms a view about authorship acts against the candidate, with effects that can reach the whole diploma rather than one component. The tutor who supplied the text is not investigated and does not lose anything. Any tutor willing to take that brief is accepting money to transfer a risk onto a seventeen-year-old, which is the clearest possible signal about whether to employ him for anything.

faqs.question: How much help is both legitimate and genuinely useful?
faqs.answer: Less than most families expect, concentrated at a few points. A planning session, an adversarial session on the question, a short weekly check-in through the reading months, a review after the first full draft, and a conversation before the final reflection. That is roughly a weekly hour at most, clustered at four or five moments across the project. A tutor proposing several sessions a week on an independent research essay is either padding the engagement or expecting to do work that belongs to the student, and the second one is the dangerous version.

faqs.question: How does the essay fit around Internal Assessments and mocks in DP2?
faqs.answer: Badly, unless somebody is actively triaging. The first full draft usually falls in the same stretch as Internal Assessment drafts in two or three subjects and the TOK essay, and mocks and university applications follow. A student left to choose will protect whatever is due soonest, which is almost never the essay. A tutor who has your school's published dates can tell her which deadline is recoverable in an evening and which is not, and that judgement is often worth more in DP2 than the subject teaching is.

faqs.question: Does the private tutor talk to our school's Extended Essay supervisor?
faqs.answer: No. The supervisor is appointed by the school, runs the supervised reflection sessions and signs the official record, and a tutor neither replaces nor contacts them. The tutor's job is to make sure your child arrives at each reflection able to describe her own progress accurately. Forward any written comment the supervisor has made and the tutor will work with it, but every message going back to the school comes from your child or from you. A tutor who offers to speak to the school has misunderstood his position.

faqs.question: What if a month passes with no visible progress?
faqs.answer: Tell us in that week and check the right markers first. On an Extended Essay, month-one progress looks like a narrower question, a dated search log and a reference list that grew while she read, not like pages of prose. If those exist, the project is on track and the expectation needs moving. If they do not, the match is not working and we rematch rather than persevere. The question we ask you is simple: is she doing more of this herself than she was in week one? If the answer is less, we stop and reset.

faqs.question: How does replacing a private tutor work?
faqs.answer: Message us with what specifically did not work and fresh profiles follow. On this assessment the usual mismatch is subject distance, where the tutor knows the field broadly but has never researched the corner your child chose, so his questions stay general and she stays stuck. Pace is the other one. Both are solved by a different tutor rather than by a conversation with the current one. Nothing about a replacement goes to the school, your child's supervisor relationship is untouched, and the written plan from the first session carries over.

faqs.question: Can my daughter use AI tools while writing the essay?
faqs.answer: Only within her school's published rules, and she declares whatever she uses herself. Schools differ and the guidance is being revised, so the authority is your DP coordinator's current position rather than a tutor's opinion. A tutor will teach her the difference between a tool that helps her find or organise material and one that produces text or analysis she then submits, because the second puts the diploma at risk. Anything generated by a model is not her work, and the declaration she signs says the essay is hers.

sections.heading: What does an IB DP extended essay tutor in Mumbai do that the supervisor does not?
paragraphs: A supervisor is appointed by the school, meets your child formally, records the reflection sessions on the school's own form, and submits the final comment. None of that is available to anyone else, and nobody should offer it to you. An IB DP extended essay tutor in Mumbai does something different and smaller: teaches the research and writing skills the student is assumed to already have, presses on whether the question can actually be answered in the space available, teaches how to build an argument that runs from first page to last, and reads a draft the student has written against the published criteria. That is the whole offer, and it is worth real money precisely because it is bounded.

So the first thing we ask is what the supervisor has already said. Send us the subject the essay is in, where the student is in the process, and any written supervisor comment, even one line. The second thing we ask is the subject itself, because the single most useful match is a tutor who works inside that discipline. A History essay and a Biology essay are judged on the same criteria and succeed for completely different reasons, and a generalist who has read the criteria can mark the structure but not the substance.

We shortlist two or three tutors, you take one paid session, and if the fit is wrong we match again within a few working days with nothing to argue about. One rule we hold firmly: the tutor does not contact your child's school, does not email the supervisor, does not ask to see internal documents, and does not offer an opinion on how the supervision is being run. If you want something raised with the school, you or your child raise it.

sections.heading: Where the Extended Essay sits in the IB Diploma Programme, and who owns which part
paragraphs: The Extended Essay (EE) is part of the core of the International Baccalaureate (IB) Diploma Programme (DP), sat alongside six subjects and Theory of Knowledge (TOK) rather than as a subject in its own right. It is an independent piece of research written to a word limit set in the current guide, in a subject the student registers it under, and it is the only piece of work in the Diploma where the student is formally the researcher and an adult is formally the supervisor. Higher Level (HL) and Standard Level (SL) make no difference to it; everyone writes one.

The ownership map is the part families most need and most rarely get. The school appoints the supervisor. The supervisor holds the formal reflection sessions, signs off that the work is the student's own, writes the supervisor comment, and is the only adult with any standing in the process. The student owns the question, the reading, the data, the drafting and every word submitted. A private tutor owns nothing in the process at all, which is exactly why a tutor is free to be useful: no sign-off to protect, no form to complete, no institutional relationship to manage.

An Extended Essay (EE) IB Diploma Programme (DP), Years 1-2 tutor Mumbai families engage is therefore not a substitute supervisor and should never describe themselves as one. The honest description is a coach for the skills the essay assumes. Many DP students in Mumbai have never designed a research question, never written anything of this length, and never had to structure an argument across multiple sections. Those are teachable, and the school timetable rarely has room to teach them.

We will not print the word count, the number of reflection sessions, the marking bands or how the essay combines with TOK towards the Diploma, because the IB revises these on its own cycle and your school's DP coordinator holds what applies to your child's cohort. Ask the coordinator for the current guide and for your school's internal deadlines, and treat any tutoring website quoting those details from memory with suspicion.

sections.heading: Subject expertise: why a Biology EE and a History EE need different tutors
paragraphs: The Extended Essay is registered in a subject and assessed by that subject's expectations, which is why we match on discipline before anything else. A student writing in Biology has to show a method someone else could repeat, handle variables honestly, and explain what her data can and cannot support. A student writing in History has to work with sources that disagree, show why she trusts one over another, and resist writing a narrative when the question asked for an argument. Both essays are marked against the same published criteria, and the work of satisfying those criteria looks nothing alike.

This matters more than parents expect because a supervisor is not always a specialist in the subject the student registered. Schools allocate supervisors from the staff available, so a capable Economics teacher may end up supervising an essay in Visual Arts or Psychology. That supervisor can still run the process properly, hold the reflection sessions and give sound general guidance on structure and scope. What they may not be able to do is tell your daughter that her chosen statistical treatment is inappropriate for her sample, or that the historiographical debate she thinks she has found was settled decades ago. A subject-specialist tutor can, and that is a legitimate addition rather than a replacement.

The second place subject expertise shows up is in what a question can actually bear. A question that sounds excellent and cannot be answered with the data a Mumbai student can realistically gather is the commonest structural fault we see. A tutor who works in the discipline will say within twenty minutes that a primary-source project depending on archive access the student cannot obtain, or a lab-based design needing equipment her school does not have, has a problem. Saying it early is worth more than any amount of help later.

Our shortlist for an Extended Essay (EE) tutor in Mumbai therefore starts from the registered subject and the student's draft question, not from availability. If the subject is genuinely scarce, we will tell you that and offer online options across the city rather than pretend a nearby generalist is equivalent.

paragraphs: Students we work with attend Dhirubhai Ambani International School, the American School of Bombay and Ascend International School in Bandra Kurla Complex, Ecole Mondiale World School, Jamnabai Narsee International School and Utpal Shanghvi Global School in Juhu, Oberoi International School off JVLR in Goregaon East, Aditya Birla World Academy in Tardeo, B.D. IB Gram is an independent platform, not affiliated with any of these schools or with the International Baccalaureate organisation.

Across these campuses the Extended Essay is run on a schedule of internal checkpoints set well ahead of the IB's own deadline, with the reflection sessions spread across both DP years. The pressure points are predictable. The first is when the question has to be fixed, which collides with early Internal Assessment (IA) work. The second is the interim or full first draft, which in many Mumbai schools lands either side of the Diwali break and sits alongside science IA drafts and TOK work. The third is the final internal deadline, usually before the mock examinations, by which point students who have been quietly stalling can no longer hide it.

Now the case families call us about most. A supervisor teaching a full DP timetable, running a department and supervising several essays has limited hours, and some students get less contact than others. That is a staffing reality rather than a failure of anyone's goodwill. The symptoms are familiar: feedback arriving as three lines, a draft returned after four weeks, a reflection session rescheduled twice. A student in Vikhroli with a Chemistry essay, a stretched supervisor and a draft she has lost confidence in does not need someone to take over. She needs someone to read the draft properly, tell her which section is actually broken, and make her fix it herself before the next formal session.

Which is the correct use of a tutor in that situation, and worth saying plainly: the tutor makes the student better prepared for her supervisor, not independent of them. Send us your school's checkpoint dates and the tutor will plan backwards from them rather than from the IB's deadline.

sections.heading: Home tuition, online or hybrid for Extended Essay work in Mumbai?
paragraphs: Start with what each session is for. An Extended Essay checkpoint is reading a draft, asking what a section is doing, and sending the student back to work. Home tuition remains IB Gram's lead service, and an IB home tutor in Mumbai is the right call when the student is stalling, because a tutor arriving at your door on Sunday is a deadline that exists in the physical world. Home sessions also suit the stages where paper wins: laying out a chapter plan, spreading source notes across a table, or going through a marked draft page by page with the published criteria beside it. IB home tuition in Mumbai is what most of our DP1 families start with for this reason.

The honest cost of home sessions is travel priced into every hour and lost slots when traffic decides otherwise. A fortnightly weekend home visit survives a term; a weekly 7.30pm appointment that depends on Ghodbunder Road, the JVLR approach or the Western Express Highway northbound does not. Families booking Extended Essay (EE) home classes Mumbai schools schedule around should put the slot on a weekend morning and keep it there.

An IB online tutor in Mumbai suits the middle stretch better than home sessions do. Draft comments belong in a shared document where an objection sits beside the paragraph that caused it, references and data can be checked on screen together, and a twenty-minute conversation about one broken section does not need anybody to cross the city. For a scarce subject, online is also the only way to reach a genuine specialist rather than a nearby generalist, and for research work that trade is clearly worth making.

So the pattern we recommend is hybrid and uneven: a home session to set up the chapter plan, online checkpoints through the research and drafting months, and a home session before the final internal deadline to work through the complete draft on paper. A home tutor for Extended Essay (EE) Mumbai parents book for those two bookend visits costs more per hour once travel is counted, and twice a cycle it is money well spent.

sections.heading: How Extended Essay tutors are verified across Mumbai, and what to ask yourself
paragraphs: We check identity and qualifications against documents, confirm the IB teaching, examining or research supervision experience a tutor claims, and interview them in the subject they will teach rather than on method in general. For Extended Essay work the interview includes one scenario question we treat as pass or fail: a parent asks you to tidy up the conclusion the night before submission. The only acceptable answer is a refusal with an explanation, and tutors who negotiate around it do not join the platform. Tutors visiting homes confirm identity document details, and you may ask to see that identity on the first visit.

Your own checks are short and effective. Ask the tutor to describe the supervisor's role back to you, and listen for whether they place themselves outside it. Ask what they will do if your child's draft question cannot be answered with the evidence available. Ask what they will do if your child reports that the supervisor has advised something the tutor disagrees with. The right answer to the last one is that the tutor explains their reasoning to your child and then tells her to follow her supervisor and raise the disagreement with them herself. Be wary of any tutor who offers a guaranteed grade, promises a specific grade, or implies they can speak to the school on your behalf. We do not guarantee grades.

The boundary is worth stating in full because it is the whole reason this page exists. The work must be the student's own. A tutor may teach research method, question a research question until it is answerable, teach how to structure an argument, explain what a published criterion is asking for, and comment on a draft the student has already written. A tutor may never write, redraft, research for, or supply any part of the essay, never gather or clean the data, never contact the school or the supervisor, and never complete any part of a reflection. Any use of artificial intelligence tools is declared under your school's rules, and a tutor who suggests otherwise should be removed from the project immediately.

The last check is one only you can make, because an IB DP extended essay tutor in Mumbai works between your child and her own drafts. Look at a returned draft. If the margin holds questions your child has to answer, the booking is working. If it holds sentences she can paste, the essay has stopped being hers and the submission is at risk in a way no grade improvement would compensate for.

sections.heading: The boundary in practice: what a tutor may add, and what is never theirs to touch
paragraphs: Three lists make this concrete. What the supervisor owns: the formal reflection sessions, the record of them on the school's form, confirming the work is the student's own, the supervisor comment, and all authority over the process. A private tutor cannot see those documents, cannot influence them, and cannot stand in for the person completing them. What a tutor may legitimately add: teaching how research is designed and how evidence is weighed, pressing on the question until the student can say what would count as an answer, teaching how to structure a long argument so each section earns its place, explaining what a published criterion asks for in that subject, and marking a draft the student wrote. What a tutor must never do: write any sentence of the essay, rewrite one, research for the student, gather or process her data, contact the school or supervisor, or touch a reflection.

The failure this prevents is subtler than plagiarism and far more common. A tutor who dictates while the student types, or who hands back a draft with improved sentences rather than questions, has moved the authorship line without anyone deciding to. By the time the essay is submitted, the student cannot explain her own choices, which shows in the final reflection and in any conversation with her supervisor. Nobody set out to cheat; the work simply stopped being hers one helpful suggestion at a time.

The second thing a careful tutor manages is the risk of putting a student between two adults who disagree. It happens easily: the supervisor suggests narrowing the question, the tutor thinks the narrowing loses the interesting part, and a sixteen-year-old is now holding two instructions and no authority. Our rule is that the supervisor's guidance governs. A tutor may explain why they would have advised differently, and must then tell the student to follow her supervisor or go back and discuss it with them directly, in her own words. A tutor who encourages a student to work around her supervisor is creating a problem that lands on the student alone, months later, in a conversation the tutor will not attend.

Handled that way, the stretched-supervisor case resolves cleanly. The student arrives at her next formal session with a sharper question, a draft she can defend and three specific things she wants advice on. Her supervisor, who has limited hours, can now spend them well. That is the realistic ceiling on what a tutor contributes to an Extended Essay, and it is a genuinely useful ceiling rather than a disappointing one.

sections.heading: What should Extended Essay progress look like at four weeks and one term?
paragraphs: At four weeks the deliverable is clarity, not pages. Your child should be able to state her question and say, in one sentence, what evidence would count as an answer to it and what she will do if that evidence points the other way. She should also know which section she is writing next and why. If after a month of sessions she is still describing her topic rather than her question, the tutor is being pleasant rather than useful and you should say so directly. The other four-week signal is whether she works between sessions, because an Extended Essay is mostly unsupervised hours and tuition cannot replace them.

At one term, with a draft or a substantial part of one written, the markers are specific. Each section can be described in terms of the job it does in the argument. Her sources or data are hers, she can explain why she trusts them, and she can say what they cannot show. She has met at least one result or source that complicated her position and has written about it rather than quietly dropping it. And she goes into her formal reflection sessions with her own questions prepared, which is the single clearest sign the tuition is working inside the boundary rather than around it.

Over a full cycle, the honest spread. Students who start in DP1 and keep fortnightly checkpoints usually submit work they can defend. Students who arrive two months before the internal deadline with a vague question and no reading can be helped to produce something coherent, and that is salvage, which we will name as salvage when you call. Students who will not do the unsupervised hours do not get better, whatever anyone charges. We do not guarantee grades, and a tutor who offers to is telling you they do not understand how this piece of work is assessed.

On changing tutors: message us, we shortlist again within a few working days, and you pay only for sessions taken. Two pieces of feedback we act on immediately are she came back with corrected English and no questions and the tutor keeps telling her to ignore her supervisor. The first is a competence mismatch. The second ends the booking the same day.

sections.heading: Booking Extended Essay home tuition or online sessions in Mumbai: what to send
paragraphs: Four things make a first message actionable: the subject the essay is registered in, the current draft question in your child's own words, where she is in the school's checkpoint schedule, and any written supervisor feedback however brief. Add your area and two workable windows, ideally weekend mornings if you want home tuition. If there is a draft, send it. If there is only a title and a feeling of panic, send that, because it is a normal starting point in DP2 and it changes who we shortlist rather than whether we can help.

On cost, the honest version. IB tuition fees in Mumbai move with several factors and no single figure is meaningful. Subject scarcity matters most on Extended Essay work, because a specialist in a less-taught subject is harder to find than a Mathematics tutor and prices accordingly. Session length matters, since ninety minutes with a draft open is the useful unit and sixty is often not. Travel is the biggest variable on home bookings, and a tutor crossing from Andheri to Panvel for a weekday evening is selling you one hour of teaching and two of their evening. Ask for home and online rates separately, ask what a weekend slot costs, and note that fortnightly checkpoints over two terms often cost less in total than a weekly booking over one.

Session one covers three things. The tutor reads the question aloud and asks what would count as an answer, which exposes most structural problems within half an hour. Then they look at whatever exists, against the published criteria for that subject. Then they agree the next piece of work, which is always your child's to do. You get a short written note the same evening naming what the current research design cannot support. If that note could have been written about any essay, tell us and we shortlist again.

Parents arrive here from all sorts of searches, including plain ones like IB tutors near me Mumbai, and some have already been pitched an IB private tutor Mumbai agencies promise will handle the whole thing. The question worth asking is not who the best IB tutor in Mumbai is, because that depends entirely on the subject and the student. The question is what the tutor will refuse to do. A tutor who answers that one clearly is the one to book, and a tutor who cannot is a risk to a submission your child has to stand behind.

faqs.question: Can a tutor speak to my child's supervisor or the school about the essay?
faqs.answer: No, and a tutor offering to is a reason to look elsewhere. The supervisor is appointed by the school and the relationship is between the school, the supervisor and your child. A private tutor has no standing in it, cannot see the reflection records, and should never email, call or request documents from the school. If something needs raising, your child raises it with her supervisor or you contact the school yourself. What a tutor does is prepare her to use her supervisor's limited time well, with a sharper question and specific things to ask.

faqs.question: Our supervisor is stretched and feedback is thin. Is a tutor the right answer?
faqs.answer: Often yes, provided the tutor works inside the boundary. A supervisor teaching a full timetable and supervising several essays has limited hours, and some students get three lines where they needed a page. A tutor can read the draft properly, tell your child which section is actually broken, and make her repair it herself before her next formal session. What a tutor cannot do is take over the supervision, and you should decline any offer to. The outcome you want is a student who arrives better prepared, not one who has quietly replaced her supervisor.

faqs.question: What if the tutor disagrees with what the supervisor told my child to do?
faqs.answer: The supervisor's guidance governs. A good tutor explains why they would have advised differently, then tells your child to follow her supervisor or go back and discuss the disagreement with them in her own words. What must not happen is a sixteen-year-old carrying two sets of instructions from two adults who have never spoken. If a tutor encourages your child to work around her supervisor, end the booking. That advice creates a problem months later, in a conversation about her own essay that the tutor will not be present for.

faqs.question: Can a tutor help write or fix the essay if we are running out of time?
faqs.answer: No. A tutor may teach research method, press on the question, teach how to structure an argument, explain what a published criterion asks for, and comment on a draft your child has written. A tutor may never write, redraft, research for, or supply any part of the essay, never gather or process the data, and never touch a reflection. Any use of artificial intelligence tools is declared under your school's rules. Under time pressure a tutor can help her produce her own coherent draft quickly, which is salvage rather than teaching, and we will say so plainly.

faqs.question: Will a tutor travel to our building in Thane or Navi Mumbai for Extended Essay sessions?
faqs.answer: Yes, within the corridor or node the tutor already lives in. We match Thane tutors along Pokhran and Ghodbunder Roads to Thane families, and Navi Mumbai tutors across Vashi, Nerul, Belapur, Kharghar and Panvel. For research work we push hard for a weekend morning rather than a weekday evening, because a 7.30pm checkpoint that depends on Ghodbunder Road or the Atal Setu will be lost in the fortnight you need it most. Society gate clearance is arranged once as a recurring entry rather than a fresh visitor pass every session.

faqs.question: How often do Extended Essay sessions need to happen?
faqs.answer: Fortnightly suits most students better than weekly, because the essay runs on unsupervised hours and a checkpoint only works if there is new work to check. A weekly booking in the early months usually means the tutor is filling time, and we would rather tell you that than take the fee. The exceptions are the weeks around a chapter plan and the fortnight before an internal deadline, where weekly is sensible. Over two terms, fortnightly checkpoints with two intensive stretches typically costs less than a weekly booking and produces better work.

faqs.question: How much does an Extended Essay tutor cost in Mumbai?
faqs.answer: There is no single rate and we publish none. Subject scarcity is the dominant factor here: a specialist in a less-commonly-taught subject costs more for the same hour than a Mathematics tutor, and for research work that specialism is what you are buying. Session length matters because ninety minutes with the draft open is the useful unit. Travel is the largest variable on home bookings. Ask any tutor for a home rate, an online rate and a weekend rate separately, and ask whether a ninety-minute session is priced proportionally.

faqs.question: My daughter's question sounds impressive but she cannot find data. What now?
faqs.answer: That is the most common structural fault in the Extended Essay and it is cheaper to fix early than to write around. A question is only usable if the evidence it needs can actually be gathered by a student in Mumbai with school-level resources. A subject-specialist tutor will spot the problem in one session: archive access that will not be granted, equipment the school does not have, a survey population that cannot be reached honestly. The repair belongs to your daughter and her supervisor, who signs off on the process, but a tutor can make her see the problem before three months have gone into it.

faqs.question: Does a tutor need to be in the same subject as the essay?
faqs.answer: Strongly yes. The criteria are the same across subjects but satisfying them looks completely different: a Biology essay stands on method and honest limits, a History essay on disagreement between sources. A generalist can mark structure and clarity, and that is worth something, but cannot tell your child that her statistical treatment is wrong for her sample or that the debate she thinks she has discovered was resolved long ago. If the subject is scarce in your area, take a specialist online rather than a nearby generalist at your table.

faqs.question: Is online as good as a tutor at home for this kind of work?
faqs.answer: For the middle months, usually better. Draft comments belong in a shared document where an objection sits beside the paragraph causing it, and data or references can be checked on screen together. Home tuition wins at two points: setting out a chapter plan on paper, and going through a complete draft page by page before the final internal deadline. Home sessions also break a stall, because a tutor arriving on Sunday is a real deadline. Most of our families run a hybrid, and we would rather you spent the travel premium twice than weekly.

faqs.question: What happens if the tutor is not working out?
faqs.answer: Message us and we shortlist again, usually within a few working days, with no notice period and payment only for sessions already taken. Tell us what was wrong in plain language, because it changes the match. The tutor only corrected her English points to a competence mismatch and we will send a subject specialist. The tutor keeps offering to rewrite sections, or told her to ignore her supervisor, ends the booking the same day and we will tell you that we have removed them from the project.

Confident young filmmakers summarise plots, describe what happens, and lose the marks that go to precise analysis. IB Gram matches Diploma Programme Film specialists for weekly home classes across the city, and we do not guarantee grades.
