sections.heading: How is an IB DP Spanish B home tutor in Mumbai checked?
paragraphs: Before a tutor is listed, we verify identity with a government photo document, confirm the qualifications they claim in Spanish and in teaching, and check their subject history by asking for specifics only a real Spanish B teacher can give. Which text types have you taught to a DP class? Walk me through how you prepare a student for the follow-up questions after a visual stimulus. How do you mark a written task so the student knows what to change? Vague answers end the conversation. We also ask for references we can actually call, and we check that a tutor claiming Diploma experience can describe the difference between teaching Spanish B and teaching a beginners course.

What we cannot do is sit in your living room every week, which is why half of verification belongs to the parent. Ask for a marked sample of a student's written task with the tutor's comments on it, names removed. Comments that quote criteria language and name a specific fix are the signal. A score and the word 'good' is not. Ask what the first four weeks will cover and whether you will see the error log. Sit within earshot of the second session, not the first, when both of them have stopped performing.

Be wary of anyone who offers a guaranteed grade, and treat a tutor who promises a specific grade in Spanish B as someone who has not understood the assessment. Be equally wary of an offer to 'help with' a written task in a way that means producing text for the student. The boundary is covered in detail below and it is not negotiable. Any IB home tutor in Mumbai worth booking will state it themselves before you ask.

One Spanish-specific check. Ask which varieties of Spanish the tutor is comfortable teaching and how they handle a student whose school materials come from Spain while their listening practice is largely Latin American. The right answer is that peninsular and Latin American Spanish are both fully legitimate, that students are routinely taught either, and that the useful work is building recognition across the Spanish-speaking world rather than correcting one variety into another. A tutor who treats a student's Spanish as wrong because it is not their own has told you something important.

sections.heading: What may a tutor mark, and what must the student write alone?
paragraphs: A tutor may teach, may explain, may question, may mark and may hand back detailed feedback. A tutor may not write, redraft, dictate, translate or supply any part of a submission the student puts their name to. There is no soft version of that line. A written task that contains a tutor's sentences is not the student's work, and the risk sits entirely on the student, which is reason enough to be rigid about it before anyone is tired and a deadline is three days away.

In practice the line is easy to hold once everyone knows where it runs. The tutor can say that the second paragraph loses the register because it slips into the second person singular with an audience that requires formal address, and can teach the formal register for an hour. The tutor cannot write the replacement paragraph. The tutor can mark that a conclusion asserts an opinion with no supporting example, and can drill opinion-with-evidence structures using three unrelated prompts. The tutor cannot supply the example. The student writes every word, every time, and improves faster that way because the correction has to pass through their own hands to become a habit.

The tool that makes this work is an error log built from the student's own recurring mistakes, not from a generic grammar syllabus. After three marked tasks, almost every student has a short, stable list: ser and estar confused in descriptions of states, preterite used where the imperfect is needed for background, agreement lost on adjectives once a sentence runs long, por and para swapped under time pressure, the subjunctive missing after expressions of doubt, and one or two false friends that keep reappearing. That list is the curriculum. Working through a textbook chapter on the subjunctive when the student's real leak is adjective agreement spends an hour buying nothing.

The same logic applies to the oral. Memorised sentences are brittle: twelve rehearsed lines give a student twelve lines and nothing for the follow-up questions. Rehearsed structures are flexible. A student who can reliably build a comparison, a hypothesis, a cause-and-effect chain, a concession and an opinion-with-evidence can assemble a response to a stimulus they have never seen, which is the actual test. We ask tutors to drill five structures across unrelated images rather than script one answer, and to record short practices so the student hears their own filler words. A home tutor for Spanish B Mumbai parents book for the oral should be running that loop by the third session.

sections.heading: What progress looks like at four weeks, one term and one exam cycle
paragraphs: At four weeks, do not expect a grade to move. Expect the error log to exist and to be short, expect the student to be able to say what text type a prompt is asking for and who the audience is before writing, and expect two or three marked tasks in the folder with comments specific enough that you can read them and understand what changed. If after a month there is no written work with corrections on it, something is wrong with the arrangement rather than with the student.

At one term, the measurable changes are usually these. Written tasks open in the right register and stay there. The student plans before writing instead of starting on the first sentence. Recurring errors from the first log have thinned, replaced by a newer and more advanced set, which is what improvement actually looks like. In the oral, the student can talk about an unseen image for the full presentation without running out, and can take a follow-up question that goes somewhere they did not prepare for. Fluency in the ordinary sense improves more slowly than any of this, because it is a function of hours of exposure.

Across a full exam cycle, the gains compound where the practice was deliberate and stall where it was passive. The students who move most are the ones who wrote one task a week and had it marked, kept the log current, and recorded themselves speaking even when they hated listening back. The honest limit is that a tutor controls the quality of the hour and the feedback, and not the hours between sessions, the student's sleep, the school's internal dates or how a particular examiner reads a borderline script.

So IB Gram does not guarantee grades, and no honest tutor will either. What a verified Spanish B tutor in Mumbai can be held to is specific and checkable: showing up, marking against the criteria, keeping the error log current, telling you when the student has not done the work, and saying plainly if a different tutor would suit better. If you want a number promised in advance, we are the wrong platform.

sections.heading: Starting Spanish B home tuition in Mumbai: what to prepare
paragraphs: Three things make the first session useful instead of introductory. The last two marked written tasks with the teacher's comments, however bruising. The school's internal calendar for the oral and for report dates, which your DP coordinator will have. And one sentence from the student about what they find hardest, in their own words, because a student who says 'I can write but I freeze when he asks me something I did not expect' has just handed the tutor the plan.

The first session should be a diagnosis, not a lecture. Expect roughly half of it in Spanish, including an unseen image described cold so the tutor can hear where speech breaks down under mild pressure. Expect a short piece of writing done in the session rather than at home, because the tutor needs to see what the student produces without help. Expect the hour to end with two or three named priorities and a schedule for marked work, not with a package of forty sessions.

On cost, we will not print a price list, because the number depends on things that genuinely vary: level, how scarce the subject is in your zone, how far the tutor travels, session length and how many sessions a week you want. Spanish B sits at the scarcer end in Mumbai, which affects it more than board or level does. Ask any tutor to confirm the rate, the session length and the cancellation rule in writing before the second session, and ask whether marking written work between sessions is included.

If a match is not working, say so early. One session is too soon to judge and a full term is too long to endure. After two or three sessions a parent usually knows whether the hour is structured, whether the student speaks for a reasonable share of it, and whether the feedback is specific. Tell us and we will arrange someone else, with the error log and the marked scripts handed over so the new tutor does not start from zero.

faqs.question: Do we need a parent at home, and what study space does a home tuition session need?
faqs.answer: Someone over eighteen should be in the flat, and the session should happen in a shared room rather than a bedroom. Beyond that, Spanish B needs less than most subjects: a table, two chairs, the student's folder and textbook, and a room quiet enough to record a two-minute speaking practice without the television behind it. Speaking work is the reason the door stays open rather than closed, and it is also the reason a dining table beats a study desk in a corner. Wifi matters only if the tutor is playing audio from a phone or laptop.

faqs.question: My daughter can speak Spanish but freezes in the individual oral. Can that be fixed in a term?
faqs.answer: Yes, and freezing is usually a preparation problem rather than a language problem. Students who memorise answers have nothing left the moment a follow-up question goes somewhere unscripted, and the freeze is the gap between the script running out and improvisation starting. The work is to replace scripts with structures: comparison, hypothesis, cause and effect, concession, and opinion supported by an example. Drill those five across images she has never seen, record each attempt, and the panic drops because she always has a next move. Six short practices across a term do more than a weekend of rehearsal.

faqs.question: Can the tutor help with the Paper 1 written task without writing it?
faqs.answer: Yes, and that distinction is the whole job. A tutor may teach text types and register, mark a draft against the published criteria, question a weak paragraph until the student sees the problem, and drill the structures the student keeps getting wrong. A tutor may not write, redraft, translate or dictate any part of what your child submits. If a tutor offers to tidy up a submission, end the arrangement. The practical version is that the student writes in the session, the tutor marks it, and the student rewrites it themselves afterwards.

faqs.question: Our school uses materials from Spain but the listening practice sounds Latin American. Is that a problem?
faqs.answer: No, and it is worth saying clearly that peninsular and Latin American Spanish are equally legitimate. The Spanish-speaking world runs across Spain, Mexico, the countries of Central and South America and the Caribbean, with real differences in pronunciation, vocabulary and how the second person is used. A student may be taught any of these varieties and none of them is a deficient version of another. What examinations reward is recognising variation and being consistent within one register. A good tutor builds exposure across varieties and stops a student being thrown by an accent they have not heard before.

faqs.question: What do IB tuition fees in Mumbai depend on for a subject like Spanish B?
faqs.answer: Level, subject scarcity, travel distance, session length and how many sessions a week you book, with scarcity mattering most here. Spanish B has far fewer experienced Diploma teachers in Mumbai than Mathematics or Economics, so a tutor who has genuinely taught both years of the course prices differently from a conversational Spanish teacher. Travel is the second factor: a tutor giving up ninety minutes of road time around your hour in Powai or Thane reflects that. We do not publish a rate card. Ask your shortlisted tutor to confirm the figure and whether marking between sessions is included.

faqs.question: Is an IB online tutor in Mumbai as good as home classes for the oral?
faqs.answer: For the oral specifically, home classes have a small real edge, because a student sitting across a table cannot hide behind a screen and the tutor catches hesitation as it happens. Online is still a strong option and for some families the better one: it removes travel, widens the pool of experienced Spanish B teachers well past your zone, and makes a second weekly session realistic. The compromise most of our families reach is hybrid, with one home visit for speaking and marked writing plus a shorter online session for review.

faqs.question: There has been no visible progress after a month. What should we do?
faqs.answer: Ask for the evidence before you change tutors, because a month is too early for a grade to move but not too early for process to be visible. There should be two or three marked written tasks, an error log of recurring mistakes drawn from the student's own work, and a short list of named priorities. If all of that exists, the arrangement is working and the grade follows later. If the folder is empty and sessions have been conversation practice, that is a real problem and we will move you to a different tutor with the diagnosis carried over.

faqs.question: Our son is in DP2 in Powai and his oral is a few weeks away. Is it too late to start?
faqs.answer: Not too late, but the plan has to change shape. With a few weeks the work is narrow: drill four or five flexible structures, practise analytical description on unseen images, and run short recorded attempts with follow-up questions every session. Nobody should be rewriting his grammar foundations now. faqs.question: What happens if the tutor is not working out after a few sessions?
faqs.answer: Tell us and we arrange a replacement, and you do not need to justify it beyond a sentence. The useful signals after two or three sessions are whether the hour has a structure, whether the student is speaking for a reasonable share of it, and whether written work comes back with comments that name a fix. If any of those is missing, the match is wrong rather than the student being difficult. We hand the error log and the marked scripts to the next tutor so the first weeks are not repeated.

Be wary of a tutor who offers a guaranteed grade, because the offer tells you they have not read the assessment criteria. What you can hold a tutor to is attendance, marking against the criteria, a current error log, and honesty when the student has not done the work.

sections.heading: Spanish B at SL and HL over video, and what each level needs
paragraphs: Spanish B is the Diploma Programme (DP) language acquisition course for students who already have Spanish behind them. In Mumbai that prior learning almost always came from a school option block and nowhere else, which is the single fact that shapes everything about how it should be taught. Whether your child sits Standard Level (SL) or Higher Level (HL), and whether Spanish B is the right course for them at all, is settled by the school together with the family before the two years begin. We do not involve ourselves in that, and a tutor who offers to influence a placement is overreaching. What a tutor can do is report what they see in the student's speaking and writing, which is useful evidence for the conversation you have with the Diploma coordinator.

Standard Level (SL) students over video benefit most from frequency. Two shorter sessions a week beat one long one, because speaking and listening are stamina skills and stamina responds to repetition rather than to duration. A ninety-minute video call with a tired DP1 student at 8pm produces less usable Spanish than two forty-minute calls on a Tuesday and a Saturday. Higher Level (HL) adds a literature element, and that is where the format earns itself in a different way: a tutor can put the text on screen, annotate it live while the student reads aloud, and keep the annotated version in the shared folder. A student at Ascend International School working through literary prose can see their own reading history build up week by week.

The rest of the Diploma crowds in around all this. The Extended Essay (EE), Theory of Knowledge (TOK) and the Internal Assessment (IA) tasks in other subjects take the same evenings, and Spanish is reliably the first thing a student drops. An IB online tutor in Mumbai has one structural advantage here: a forty-minute call can survive a week when a ninety-minute house visit cannot, so the habit does not break. Families often want a Spanish B IB Diploma Programme (DP), Years 1-2 tutor Mumbai schools will still be working with in the second May session, and continuity over video is easier to protect than continuity that depends on a tutor's commute surviving two years.

sections.heading: Which parts of Spanish B does an online tutor handle best?
paragraphs: Listening and speaking, decisively. The two written papers can be prepared over video too, but listening and speaking are where an IB DP Spanish B online tutor in Mumbai does something a tutor in your living room cannot do as easily. Listening needs volume and variety of authentic audio, and a tutor with a browser open can pull a radio interview from Buenos Aires, a news bulletin from Mexico City, a cooking video from Seville and a podcast from Bogota into one session without owning a single CD. Speaking needs a partner who will not drift into English, and a video call with a shared screen and a visible timer is a surprisingly disciplined environment for that.

The exposure problem is specific to this city and worth naming plainly. A Mumbai student hears Hindi, Marathi, English and Gujarati around them all day and Spanish for a few timetabled periods a week. Nothing in the environment reinforces the language between Tuesday and Tuesday. A student in Madrid learning English is swimming in English; a student in Kandivali East learning Spanish is not swimming in anything. That gap is what an online tutor is best placed to close, because closing it means putting real Spanish at real speed in front of the student repeatedly, and that is a logistics problem the internet solves and a car does not.

The reading paper and the writing task both work over video with one caveat each. Reading is fine: an unseen passage goes on screen and the tutor watches where the student's eyes stop. Writing is the component that needs a deliberate workaround, because the examination papers are handwritten and a student who has done two years of practice in a text box will arrive with a hand that cramps and handwriting nobody can mark. We deal with that by having the student write on paper during the call, photograph it, and upload it before the next session. Spanish B home classes Mumbai families book for the written work solve the same problem by being physically present, which is one honest argument for hybrid.

sections.heading: Online, home classes or hybrid for an IB DP Spanish B tutor in Mumbai?
paragraphs: Take online when the gap you are closing is exposure and speaking time. An IB DP Spanish B online tutor in Mumbai can run four sessions a week if you want them, pull authentic material from across the Spanish-speaking world mid-sentence, and keep a single growing document of corrections that you can read at any point. The format's real weakness is oversight. A camera shows you a face and a voice; it does not show you the phone on the student's knee, the dictionary tab open in another window, or the notebook that has not been touched since September. For a self-starting DP2 student that costs nothing. For a drifting DP1 student it costs a term.

Take home tuition when the student needs to be held to the hour rather than taught harder. A home tutor for Spanish B Mumbai parents book for a fixed weekday evening sees the physical evidence, can take the phone off the table, and can give you five minutes at the end that no chat message replaces. The limits are supply and travel: there are not many Spanish B specialists here, they cluster in the Western Suburbs and South Mumbai, and anyone running out to Kharghar or Kasarvadavali at 6pm is spending two hours to deliver one. That shows up either in the rate or in the slot quietly getting harder to keep.

Hybrid is what most families end up with, and we recommend it without pretending it is a compromise. The usual shape is one home session a week for written work, handwriting practice and the parent conversation, plus one or two shorter online sessions for speaking and listening where the travel would otherwise cost more than the teaching. In the weeks before the school's oral date, weight shifts to the online sessions. In the weeks before mocks it shifts back to paper. An IB private tutor Mumbai families use across both formats keeps one error list rather than two, which is the practical reason to prefer one person doing both over splitting the subject between two.

sections.heading: Inside the hour: speaking time, live correction and the shared error file
paragraphs: A well-run online Spanish B hour is uncomfortable for the student and quiet for the tutor. It opens with four or five minutes of unscripted Spanish on something ordinary, the weekend, a film, the state of the lift in their building, with no preparation and no English permitted. While the student talks, the tutor types into a document both of them can see: not corrections yet, just the errors as they fall, verbatim. The student watches their own mistakes accumulate in real time, which is far more effective than hearing them listed afterwards, and it trains the habit of self-monitoring that the examination room will demand when nobody is correcting anything.

The middle of the hour is input. An IB DP Spanish B online tutor in Mumbai should be putting unfamiliar audio and video in front of the student at genuine native speed, not the slowed-down classroom recordings that build false confidence. A news clip from Mexico, a street interview from Lima, a regional weather bulletin from Galicia, a Caribbean music programme: different speeds, different accents, different vocabulary, all of them legitimate Spanish. The point is not that the student understands everything. The point is that the student learns to extract meaning from partial comprehension without panicking, which is the actual skill the listening paper tests and the one a Mumbai student has fewest chances to practise anywhere else.

What persists between sessions is the file. By the end of a term it holds two lists: the student's recurring errors, numbered and dated so repetition is visible, and a growing set of usable phrases the student has actually produced and can reach for under pressure. That file is the single most valuable artefact of online tutoring and it is why we tell parents to ask for it before they commit. Listening stamina is built in the gaps: fifteen minutes of Spanish audio on the school run along the Eastern Express Highway or the Western Express Highway, five days a week, does more for the listening paper than an extra session. A student who watches one Spanish-language series with Spanish subtitles across a term arrives in February measurably different from one who did not.

sections.heading: Progress, honest limits and what online Spanish B tuition costs
paragraphs: At four weeks the measurable change is behavioural. The student talks for longer before switching to English. They stop apologising mid-sentence and restart in Spanish instead. The shared error file shows the same four items repeating, which sounds like failure and is actually the point, because named repetition is what precedes correction. If after four weeks the file is empty or generic, or the student is still speaking for ten minutes of a sixty-minute call, the match is wrong and you should tell us. At one term, listening should have shifted: audio that was noise in July is partially intelligible, and the student can summarise an unfamiliar clip rather than catching isolated words.

Across a full examination cycle a realistic outcome is a student who is no longer afraid of unfamiliar Spanish at speed, who has a method for each component, and whose weaknesses are known rather than discovered under examination conditions. That is what tutoring can deliver. Nobody can promise a specific grade, and a tutor who names a number before the trial session has told you something about themselves rather than about your child. We do not guarantee grades. The honest reason is that the variables that move Spanish B most, how much Spanish the student reads, hears and says in the six days between sessions, sit entirely outside the session.

On cost, we quote no price list because the number depends on your request. IB tuition fees in Mumbai move with board and level, with how scarce the subject is, with session length and frequency, and with travel. Online removes the travel component, which is the single largest saving for families in Navi Mumbai, far Thane and Dahisar East, and it is usually why a household in Kharghar can afford two weekly sessions online where one home session was already stretching things. Higher Level (HL) work with the literature element costs more than Standard Level (SL) support, as any specialist skill does. Spanish B sits at the scarce end of the subject range in this city, and an honest platform tells you that before you start rather than after.

One term: unfamiliar audio becomes summarisable rather than impenetrable
An error file still showing the same four items is working, not failing
Fees depend on level, scarcity, frequency and travel, which online removes
Two online sessions often cost what one home session with travel does

sections.heading: Your first online session, with home tuition available alongside
paragraphs: Prepare three things and the trial session pays for itself. Send the last two pieces of marked Spanish work, because a teacher's margin comments are the fastest diagnosis available. Send the school's internal date for the individual oral once the Diploma coordinator has issued it, since the speaking work has to peak there. And check the practical setup before the call rather than during it: a laptop rather than a phone, headphones so the student hears consonants rather than room noise, a notebook and pen on the desk, and a door that closes. A student doing Spanish on a phone in a room with the television on will not speak freely, and that has nothing to do with the tutor.

The trial is a diagnosis run as a conversation. Expect unscripted speaking, an unseen reading passage on screen, unfamiliar audio played once at full speed, and a short handwritten paragraph photographed at the end. Expect the tutor to type while the student talks, and expect to receive that document along with a written note naming three or four specific weaknesses and what the first month will do about them. Read the note properly. If it says the student needs more vocabulary and more confidence, it is worth nothing; ask for specifics or ask us for a different name. Good IB home tuition in Mumbai and good online tutoring are judged by the same test, which is whether the diagnosis is specific enough to disagree with.

Changing tutors is free and expected, and week three is a better time than February. Send us one or two sentences on what went wrong, because the detail decides the next suggestion: a student who needed a firmer hand gets a different person from one who was being pushed past their level. We do not tie you to a term or a package. Many families run one online session and one home session from the start, and if you want a Spanish B tutor in Mumbai who can do both, say so at the enquiry stage so we filter for people who are available in person as well as over video. Most households that keep the same tutor through both Diploma years settled on their second match, which is normal for a subject this scarce.

faqs.question: Does online tutoring really work for a speaking subject like Spanish B?
faqs.answer: Yes, and for speaking it is often better than the alternative. A video call with a shared screen is a disciplined environment: the student has a partner who will not drift into English, a visible timer, and corrections appearing in a document as they talk. A well-run hour has the student speaking for most of it, which rarely happens in a classroom of twenty. What online cannot do is supervise. If your child needs someone to take the phone off the table and check the notebook, that is an argument for home tuition, not an argument about speaking.

faqs.question: How does an online tutor handle the listening paper when we cannot sit together?
faqs.answer: By sharing audio directly, which is easier online than in person. The tutor plays unfamiliar material at full native speed through the call, from several Spanish-speaking countries rather than one, then works on what the student extracted rather than on what they missed. Between sessions the tutor sets short daily audio, which is where listening is actually built. Fifteen minutes a day on the school run does more than an extra hour of tuition. The skill being trained is extracting meaning from partial comprehension without freezing, and that needs frequency more than it needs a tutor in the room.

faqs.question: Will two years of typing on a laptop hurt my child in a handwritten exam?
faqs.answer: It can, and any tutor who has not thought about it is a problem. The written papers are handwritten, so a student who has only ever composed Spanish in a text box arrives with slow, cramping handwriting and no sense of how long a piece takes on paper. We ask online tutors to build in handwritten work: the student writes on paper during the call, photographs it, and uploads it before the next session. Doing one timed handwritten piece a week from DP1 onwards removes the problem entirely. Families who also book home classes for the written work get the same counterweight in person.

faqs.question: Can we combine online sessions with a home tutor who travels to our building?
faqs.answer: Yes, and most families settle there by the second term. The usual shape is one home session a week for written work, handwriting and the five-minute parent conversation, plus one or two shorter online sessions for speaking and listening. We would rather one person did both so there is a single error list, and we filter for in-person availability at the enquiry stage if you tell us that is what you want. Where in-person supply is genuinely thin, in Panvel or out along Ghodbunder Road for instance, the home session may have to be a weekend one.

faqs.question: Does it matter which country the tutor's Spanish comes from?
faqs.answer: No, and treat anyone who claims one variety is the correct one with caution. The Spanish-speaking world spans Spain, Mexico, Central and South America and the Caribbean, and its varieties are equally legitimate. Your child is better served by hearing several accents than by being trained on one, because the course draws material from across that range. What matters is whether the tutor has taught this specific course, can mark against the published criteria, and can explain register and text type. A tutor from Valencia and a tutor from Montevideo are equally able to do that well or badly.

faqs.question: Our building in Mulund West has unreliable internet in the evening. What then?
faqs.answer: Tell us at the enquiry stage and we plan around it rather than discovering it in week two. Practical fixes come first: run the call on a laptop over a wired connection if one exists, keep a mobile hotspot as the fallback, and agree with the tutor in advance that audio-only continues if video drops, because for Spanish the audio is the lesson. We also ask tutors to keep the shared document open so work survives a reconnection. If evening connectivity is genuinely poor, the Eastern Suburbs have reasonable in-person coverage and home tuition is the better answer.

faqs.question: What do fees depend on, and is online cheaper than a tutor who travels?
faqs.answer: Usually yes, because travel is a real cost and online removes it. Fees depend on level, on how scarce the subject is, on session length and frequency, and on how far and at what hour a tutor travels. Spanish B is scarce in Mumbai, so it sits above Mathematics or Economics at the same level, and Higher Level (HL) work with the literature element sits above Standard Level (SL). We publish no price list because quoting one would mean inventing a figure. For a household in Kharghar or Kasarvadavali, two online sessions often cost roughly what one home session with travel does.

faqs.question: How much should my child be speaking in an online session?
faqs.answer: Most of it, and this is the question that separates good tutors from pleasant ones. If a parent listens in and hears the tutor explaining for forty minutes, the hour has been wasted whatever was explained. Ask candidates directly before you book, and listen to the first ten minutes of the trial yourself. The shape to look for is a student talking without a script early on, the tutor typing errors silently rather than interrupting, and correction happening in a block afterwards. Interrupting every mistake teaches a student to stop talking, which is the opposite of the goal.

faqs.question: Can the tutor prepare my child for the individual oral over video?
faqs.answer: Yes, and it is one of the format's strengths. The school sets the oral date internally, so ask your Diploma coordinator for it and send it to us at matching. Over video the student can be recorded and then listen back, which is uncomfortable and effective: hearing your own filler words and tense slips does more than being told about them. The tutor can mark time on screen so the student learns what the expected length feels like. The boundary stays firm, though. The tutor coaches and corrects; they never write or supply the material the student presents.

faqs.question: There is no visible progress after a month of online sessions. What now?
faqs.answer: Tell us straight away and check what you are measuring first. At four weeks the honest markers are behavioural: longer stretches of Spanish before switching to English, the student naming their own recurring errors, the shared file showing specific repeated items. Ask the tutor for that file. If it is empty, generic, or the student is speaking for a small fraction of the hour, the match is wrong rather than the subject being hard. We rematch at no charge. In a language subject a bad month costs more than in a content subject, because listening and speaking do not respond to catching up.

faqs.question: Can we switch tutors, and are we locked into a package?
faqs.answer: You can switch at no charge and you are not locked into anything. Send one or two sentences explaining what was wrong, because the specifics shape the next suggestion: a student who needed firmer structure needs a different person from one who was being pushed too fast. We do not sell terms or bundles. Most families who keep one Spanish B tutor across both Diploma years are on their second match, which is normal for a scarce subject where personal fit and subject expertise both have to land. Week three is a far better time to switch than February.
